incident-bot: Triggered alert: Hosted API streaming disconnect ratio > 0.8% (eu-west) for 10m. Runbook: confluence/eng-sre/runbooks/hosted-api-streaming-disconnects

Aisha Rahman: Acknowledged. Seeing elevated downstream_cx_destroy + 499s at edge in eu-west. Correlates with rwd-edge-1.42.0 rollout.

Naomi Feldman: Support has 2 enterprise customers pinging about "stream just stops" today. One is BetaAI (SUP-4877). Another is CloudCart (no ticket yet).

Hiro Tanaka: Were also seeing some elevated retry rates from internal perf canary in eu-west. Nothing obvious at model layer.

Ethan Park: I have a config change from us-east mitigation. For eu-west, we can rollback edge or apply the same SSE route config.

Aisha Rahman: Rolling back rwd-edge-1.42.0 -> 1.41.3 in eu-west now.

incident-bot: Deployment event: rollback started (eu-west edge).

Aisha Rahman: Metrics dropping back to baseline. We should ensure CloudCart gets tracked; can someone open a SUP?

Naomi Feldman: Ill open SUP-4899 for CloudCart + link here.
